prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1244; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Records show long-standing treatment for the same condition before the crash; most of the current complaints come from it.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and subsequent headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the clinical picture seen in this presentation. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm a concussion. Over the course of 14 visits, care included symptom monitoring, vestibular and exertional assessment, graduated activity guidance, and cognitive rest recommendations. Treatment extended somewhat beyond the typical timeframe for this injury, largely because recovery of balance and concentration was gradual. Review of the available records shows the patient was under long-standing care for the same condition before the collision, and a substantial share of the current complaints appear to reflect that pre-existing condition rather than the acute injury. Billing for services rendered reflects no repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing follow-up and a return-to-activity plan have been recommended.
